properties.description: Big Freedia, born Freddie Ross Jr., is an American musician and performer known for popularizing the New Orleans genre of Bounce music. She is often credited with bringing Bounce music to a wider audience and is recognized for her energetic performances and contributions to the hip hop and bounce scenes. Big Freedia's music is characterized by its upbeat tempo, call-and-response style, and dance-centric beats.

Trombone Shorty, born Troy Andrews, is a New Orleans-based musician renowned for his virtuosity on the trombone and trumpet. He blends traditional New Orleans jazz with funk, hip hop, and R&B influences, creating a unique and energetic sound. He began performing at a young age and has become a prominent figure in contemporary jazz and funk music, known for his dynamic live performances and collaborations with various artists.

Solange Piaget Knowles (born June 24, 1986) is an American singer, songwriter, performance artist and actress whose work blends soul, R&B and experimental pop. Rising from Houston and first appearing as a teen recording artist and occasional Destiny's Child backup dancer, she moved from mainstream pop toward more adventurous, concept-driven records—notably Sol-Angel and the Hadley St. Dreams (2008), the acclaimed A Seat at the Table (2016) and When I Get Home (2019). Her music and visuals frequently explore Black identity, womanhood, family and memory; she also operates the imprint Saint Records and has been recognized with Grammy(s) and industry honors.

Tank and the Bangas is a vibrant New Orleans-based band known for their eclectic blend of funk, soul, hip hop, jazz, and R&B, combined with dynamic spoken word and poetic lyrics. The group is celebrated for their energetic live performances and genre-defying sound that incorporates elements of alternative music and improvisation.

Lizzo, born Melissa Viviane Jefferson, is an American singer, rapper, songwriter, and flutist. She blends elements of pop, hip hop, R&B, and soul in her music, often incorporating funk and dance influences. Lizzo is celebrated for her powerful vocals, charismatic stage presence, and messages of body positivity and self-love. She rose to mainstream fame with hits like "Truth Hurts" and "Good as Hell," and is known for her energetic performances and flute playing.
